concerns.text: Ensure proper path validation and containment checks when streaming documents via /api/v1/normative/download/{id} to prevent potential path traversal outside allowed storage directories.
Verify deterministic fallback behavior in RAG pipeline tests when DeepSeek API or external context embeddings are unreachable.
Ensure aria-labels on direct download buttons maintain WCAG 2.1 AA screen-reader clarity across mobile viewports.
Consider aligning query and path parameter naming conventions strictly across both OpenAPI specs and backend handler routes.
Institutional token TTL and session expiration handling should be explicitly validated under clock drift conditions.
Ensure modal focus trap handles escape key transitions smoothly without keyboard navigation leaks.
Document WWW-Authenticate challenge header format requirements explicitly in OpenAPI error schemas.
Confirm fallback font metrics in python-docx builder when Times New Roman system font is missing on target Linux deployment containers.
